lines.ruling: Ruling: ambiguity; amb.2025.carloan_ratio_places (chosen: ratio rounded half-up to six places; recorded alternatives: exact ratio, three places) on the value difference; representation on the rest. i1040gi p. 110, Schedule 1-A, Line 22: "On line 22, column (ii), enter the amount of the QPVLI, if any, that was deducted elsewhere on your return (for example, on Schedule C, Schedule E, or Schedule F)." fr-2025-24154 p. 23, proposed § 1.163-16(g)(1): "Independently deductible interest is limited to interest that is QPVLI ... and that is otherwise deductible by the taxpayer as a different type of interest"; (g)(2): the QPVLI "is reduced to the extent that the taxpayer deducts that independently deductible interest as non-QPVLI". fr-2025-24154 p. 21, proposed § 1.163-16(d)(2)(iii)(A): "payments of interest and principal are allocated to the portion of the indebtedness described in paragraph (d)(2)(i) ... and the portion ... described in paragraph (d)(2)(ii) ... on a pro rata basis", and (d)(4): "A taxpayer allocates principal and interest between the amount of the new loan that is an SPVL and the remaining portion of the indebtedness on a pro rata basis". Triage executable-triage-v2 (triage/carloan.json; 1,111 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 74 partial records): 128 of 151 comparisons agree; 21 candidate-unknown (13 on completed returns), 2 value. The candidate reads the source as the project does after BUG-0175: zero unless the loan and vehicle qualify, the Schedule C interest as reported on a loan that financed nothing else, and otherwise the Schedule C interest prorated by the loan's qualifying ratio (refinancing: smaller of the refinanced balance and the loan, over the loan). Differences: (1) value, classm.carloan.3 (refinanced; $8,596.00 interest, $2,149.00 Schedule C, $3,151.00 balance over a $12,278.00 loan): project $551.52 (ratio 0.256638), candidate $551.51 (ratio to nine places, 0.256637889) -- the register's exact-ratio alternative. (2) value, classm.carloan.2 (death; $1,268.00 entered on carloan.col_ii_input with no Schedule C): project $0.00, candidate $1,268.00; the interview asks carloan.col_ii_input only when s1.has_sc, so the record is not one the interview produces (representation). (3) The 21 candidate-unknown (stage12.car.basic, stage12.car.two_loans_cap, classm.tipjob.1) are returns without a Schedule C where the candidate still needs column (ii); Schedules E and F are refused by scope.schedule1, so without a Schedule C the QPVLI deducted elsewhere is zero, and the source itself asks the question of every filer (representation, as ruled in round 1). The candidate's extra refusal when the Schedule C interest exceeds the loan's interest (carloan.h_bus_over) fires on no record. BUG-0175 check: the fix is right. The Schedule C interest is a share of the whole loan's interest, and (d)(2)(iii)(A)/(d)(4) spread every payment of interest pro rata over the qualifying and nonqualifying parts, so the QPVLI part of it is the same ratio times it; (g)(1) admits only that part to column (ii) (p. 23 Example 1: $400 of $1,000 deducted as business interest leaves $600 of QPVLI, pp. 23-24). The refinanced branch uses the (d)(4) ratio and an inherited loan the (d)(2)(iii) ratio, both the ratios that carloan.qpvli uses, and an ineligible loan has no QPVLI, so zero. Regression stage12.car.mixed_sc_interest_prorated (interest $424.00, loan $20,000.00, $4,000.00 nonqualifying, Schedule C $106.00): column (ii) $84.80, column (iii) $254.40 = 0.8 x ($424.00 - $106.00). Project stands.

Ruling: ambiguity; amb.2025.carloan_ratio_places (chosen: ratio rounded half-up to six places; recorded alternatives: exact ratio, three places) on the value difference; representation on the rest. i1040gi p. 110, Line 22: "On line 22, column (iii), enter the total amount of the QPVLI paid or accrued on the loan during the taxable year minus the amount on line 22, column (ii)." fr-2025-24154 p. 23, proposed § 1.163-16(g)(1): "Independently deductible interest is limited to interest that is QPVLI ... and that is otherwise deductible by the taxpayer as a different type of interest"; (g)(2): the QPVLI "is reduced to the extent that the taxpayer deducts that independently deductible interest as non-QPVLI". fr-2025-24154 p. 21, proposed § 1.163-16(d)(2)(iii)(A): "payments of interest and principal are allocated to the portion of the indebtedness described in paragraph (d)(2)(i) ... and the portion ... described in paragraph (d)(2)(ii) ... on a pro rata basis", and (d)(4): "A taxpayer allocates principal and interest between the amount of the new loan that is an SPVL and the remaining portion of the indebtedness on a pro rata basis". Triage executable-triage-v2 (triage/carloan.json): 131 of 151 comparisons agree; 18 candidate-unknown (13 on completed returns), 2 value. Both subtract column (ii) from the loan's prorated QPVLI. classm.carloan.3: project $1,654.54 ($2,206.06 - $551.52), candidate $1,654.55 ($2,206.06 - $551.51), the nine-place ratio on column (ii) (register alternative). classm.carloan.2: project $5,073.00, candidate $3,805.00, only through the column (ii) amount supplied without a Schedule C (a record the interview does not produce). The candidate-unknown are column (ii)'s, on returns without a Schedule C (representation, as on 22(ii)). Project stands.
